result.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference for a 6-second, silent, 16:9 video. Preserve the perfume bottle in its exact reference position and proportions, with its original shape, pale pink colour and material appearance. Preserve the silver nozzle’s shape, finish and placement. Preserve the hanging tag’s shape, attachment and existing lettering exactly, keeping the lettering stable and legible. Preserve the clean white background and reference lighting, shadows and visual style. In one continuous shot, animate a single gentle swivel: from 0–4 seconds, the bottle slowly turns only a few degrees around its vertical axis, remaining upright and grounded, then eases to a stop; the attached tag follows naturally without swinging independently. Make one very slow, subtle camera push-in, keeping the entire bottle and tag visible. From 4–6 seconds, hold the bottle motionless in its final pose, with the camera settled and attention on the bottle and tag. Check the first frame against the supplied image and maintain consistent geometry and attachment points through the final frame. Audio off. Negatives: no cuts, hands, people, spraying, nozzle actuation, floating, wobbling, deformation, colour shifts, altered or animated lettering, added text, new objects or background changes.
